info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Loan Payments API
info.description: This API allows users to manage payments associated with specific loans. By deleting a payment entry, organizations can maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with their accounting practices. Typically used by financial institutions and loan servicers, this endpoint simplifies the process of updating loan payment data. Integrators can utilize this functionality to refine their payment management systems, providing a smoother experience for customers.

delete.summary: Remove a specific payment associated with a loan.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific payment record linked to a loan identified by its unique ID. This is useful for managing payment data and maintaining accurate financial records.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a payment associated with a specific loan. This operation removes the payment record identified by its unique payment ID within the context of the specified loan.

204.description: The payment has been successfully deleted.
